Class DefaultEmbeddingModelObservationConvention

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.ai.embedding.observation.DefaultEmbeddingModelObservationConvention
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micrometer.observation.KeyValuesConvention, io.micrometer.observation.ObservationConvention<EmbeddingModelObservationContext>, EmbeddingModelObservationConvention
